"META_DATA":
  "Name": "nvfp4_fused_moe"
  "Describe": "Routed NVFP4 mixture-of-experts forward with an explicit block-16 activation\
    \ quantize-dequantize between FC1 and FC2 and a routing-weighted BF16 sum"
  "Source": "KernelSchema@24d2b3d3ca9d4907c4e7efd9607cf78cfb1a52b2:kernel_wiki/aka-cuda-operators-20261030/operators/moe/nvfp4_fused_moe/candidate/solution.py::Model.forward"
  "Version": 2
  "Dispatch":
    "id": "split_k"
    "when": "token_count*slot_count <= 1536 and token_count <= 128 and token_count*slot_count\
      \ >= 32, and the wide GEMM2 leaf with the bulk drain is kept, so the route tile\
      \ count read from the ids of the call that fixes the launch set, summed over\
      \ experts as ceil(valid routes of the expert / 128), times (hidden_dim/128)*max(1,intermediate_dim/256)\
      \ is at least 3072, and the multi-node chain is kept, so some ids entry lies\
      \ in [0,expert_count) and the hidden_states payload is not entirely zero in\
      \ magnitude"
"REALIZATION":
  "Require":
  - "Item":
    - "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM1.MMA"
    - "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM2.MMA"
    "Choice": "tcgen05.mma kind::mxf4nvf4 with block_scale scale_vec::4X over shared-memory\
      \ operands and a TMEM accumulator, the scale blocks staged into TMEM by tcgen05.cp\
      \ 32x128b.warpx4 in the layout that instruction requires"
    "Reason": "The design keeps both operands packed and applies the E4M3 block scales\
      \ inside the product; no other primitive gives that numeric path or that scale\
      \ placement"
  - "Item": "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM1.MMA"
    "Choice": "One m128n128k64 product per kset covering the fused up and gate columns,\
      \ not a pair of 64-column products"
    "Reason": "The B image is staged as 128 contiguous rows, so the fused form halves\
      \ the issuer's serial chain per stage, which is the padded-pipe cost of this\
      \ band"
  - "Item":
    - "DESIGN.Work_schedule::GEMM1"
    - "DESIGN.Work_schedule::GEMM2"
    "Choice": "Multi-dimensional TMA boxes whose row algebra equals the Contract's\
      \ prepared_row, encoded through cuTensorMapEncodeTiled reached from cudart;\
      \ refuse the launch when a map cannot be encoded"
    "Reason": "Neither step has a cp.async staging path and GEMM1 is the only producer\
      \ of the FP32 partials, so an unencodable operand map has no correct fallback"
  - "Item": "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM1.PRODB"
    "Choice": "tile::gather4 over a plain 2-D UINT8 map of hidden_states boxed 128\
      \ bytes by one row, the four row coordinates given per instruction; refuse the\
      \ launch when hidden_dim/2 is not a multiple of 16 or is under 128 bytes"
    "Reason": "This design keeps no route-ordered activation buffer, so the gather\
      \ map is the only A operand path and has no fallback"
  - "Item": "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM2.EPI"
    "Choice": "A byte-view bulk tensor store map over rout, 64 bytes by 32 rows, requiring\
      \ hidden_dim >= 64 and route_capacity >= 32; refuse the launch without it"
    "Reason": "The bulk drain is the only store path of a full quadrant, and a partial\
      \ quadrant must keep the masked store"
  - "Item": "DESIGN.Work_schedule::Flow.Launch"
    "Choice": "griddepcontrol.wait at every node entry and griddepcontrol.launch_dependents\
      \ from one warp, with the programmatic serialization attribute on each launch"
    "Reason": "This is what makes launch_ready earlier than kernel_done while keeping\
      \ the handoff visibility the Flow declares"
  - "Item":
    - "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM1"
    - "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM2"
    "Choice": "mbarrier phase parity for the ring and item handshakes, the stage barrier\
      \ counting 34 arrivals plus the announced bytes, and tcgen05.commit for cumulative\
      \ retirement"
    "Reason": "Producers and issuer never meet at a block barrier, and the arrival\
      \ count is fixed while the announced byte term follows the clipped box count"
  - "Item":
    - "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM1"
    - "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::GEMM2"
    "Choice": "Two resident CTAs per sm, with 256 allocated TMEM columns and 106640\
      \ bytes of dynamic shared memory for GEMM1 and 114960 for GEMM2"
    "Reason": "The ring, scale and sink regions the roles use are sized to that residency,\
      \ and a wider TMEM allocation would halve it"
  - "Item":
    - "DESIGN.Math_reshape::act_scale"
    - "DESIGN.Math_reshape::act_payload"
    "Choice": "Hardware round-to-nearest-even saturating conversions, to fp8_e4m3fn\
      \ for the group scale and to E2M1 for the codes"
    "Reason": "The rounding and saturation points declared for the quantize step are\
      \ those of these conversions, not of a software table"
  "Prefer":
  - "Item": "DESIGN.Tile_pipeline::ACT.MAIN"
    "Choice": "Compile the non-folded activation without a launch-bounds annotation;\
      \ register count and residency remain toolchain-dependent"
    "Reason": "Source measurements report higher register use with folded prescales\
      \ and spills under an explicit bound; neither observation guarantees a compiler\
      \ budget"
"DESIGN":
  "Math_reshape":
    "Thesis": "Both operands stay packed NVFP4 and the tensor core applies the block-16\
      \ scales, so no decoded array exists. Routes are grouped per expert, the FC1\
      \ reduction is cut into two channel slices a separate node reduces, and its\
      \ activation operand comes from clipped gather boxes"
    "Rewrite":
    - "Name": "Route grouping and padding"
      "Math": "A route (t,s) is valid as in Contract; route_count counts them. counts[e]\
        \ counts expert e and offs is its exclusive prefix, offs[expert_count] = route_count.\n\
        route_position maps valid routes onto [0,route_count), expert e owning [offs[e],offs[e]+counts[e]);\
        \ order within an expert is an arbitrary permutation.\nroute_of[t,s] = route_position(t,s),\
        \ or -1 when invalid; route_token[r], route_slot[r], route_expert[r] invert\
        \ it.\ntile_offsets is the exclusive prefix of ceil(counts[e]/bm); tile_count\
        \ = tile_offsets[expert_count]. tile_expert[j] owns j, tile_first[j] = (j-tile_offsets[tile_expert[j]])*bm,\
        \ tile_rows(j) = min(bm,counts[tile_expert[j]]-tile_first[j]).\nTile j starts\
        \ at offs[tile_expert[j]]+tile_first[j]. Rows past tile_rows(j) are padding\
        \ and never stored by this tile; rows r >= route_count belong to no valid\
        \ route. FC1 and fc2 stage padding differently as defined below; neither encoding\
        \ traps.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "route_count":
          "meaning": "Number of valid routes"
        "route_capacity":
          "meaning": "Allocated rows of route-indexed buffers"
          "value": "token_count*slot_count"
        "bm":
          "meaning": "Route rows in one tile"
          "binding": "bind:DESIGN.Work_schedule::bm"
        "counts":
          "meaning": "Valid routes per expert"
          "shape":
          - "expert": "expert_count"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "offs":
          "meaning": "Exclusive route prefix per expert"
          "shape":
          - "expert": "expert_count+1"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "tile_count":
          "meaning": "Number of nonempty route tiles"
        "tile_bound":
          "meaning": "Upper bound on the route tile count"
          "value": "ceil_div(route_capacity,bm) + min(expert_count,route_capacity)"
        "tile_offsets":
          "meaning": "Exclusive tile prefix per expert"
          "shape":
          - "expert": "expert_count+1"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "tile_expert":
          "meaning": "Expert owning each route tile"
          "shape":
          - "tile": "tile_count"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "tile_first":
          "meaning": "First route of a tile inside its expert"
          "shape":
          - "tile": "tile_count"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "tile_rows":
          "meaning": "Valid route rows of one route tile"
        "route_of":
          "meaning": "Position of each route slot"
          "shape":
          - "token": "token_count"
          - "slot": "slot_count"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "route_token":
          "meaning": "Token of a positioned route; the FC1 operand row"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "route_slot":
          "meaning": "Slot of a positioned route; unread here"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "route_expert":
          "meaning": "Expert of a positioned route; read by ACT"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          "dtype": "int32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Evaluate every route from its own token row, fetching the expert\
          \ weights per route"
        "Gain": "One expert's weights serve a contiguous run of up to bm routes, addressed\
          \ as offsets of one buffer"
        "Cost": "0 -> about 16*route_capacity bytes of index arrays per call, plus\
          \ the per-expert and per-tile offsets"
    - "Name": "Direct clipped activation operand"
      "Math": "No route-ordered copy of the activations exists. The FC1 operand rows\
        \ are the Contract's hidden_states and hidden_states_scale themselves, addressed\
        \ through route_token: row r of a tile reads token route_token[r], so decoding\
        \ the fetched bytes gives hidden_value[route_token[r]] by the Contract's decode,\
        \ with no rescale and no rearrangement.\nA stage issues ceil(tile_rows(j)/4)\
        \ four-row gather boxes. The last box repeats the tile's first valid token\
        \ in any excess rows; later boxes are omitted. Only valid rows' scales are\
        \ fetched, so omitted payload rows and padding scales retain shared-slot bytes.\
        \ A token with no valid route is never read.\nEach of a tile's split_count*(intermediate_dim/64)\
        \ items fetches those rows over its own channel range.\n"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Copy each valid route's payload and scale bytes once into a route-ordered\
          \ buffer, then box 128 contiguous rows of it per stage"
        "Gain": "No route-ordered allocation or copy of route_capacity*hidden_dim*9/16\
          \ bytes; each stage fetches 4*ceil(tile_rows(j)/4) payload rows"
        "Cost": "A stage issues ceil(tile_rows(j)/4) four-row boxes instead of one\
          \ contiguous box, and each of a tile's items re-fetches those rows"
    - "Name": "Block-scaled packed product in two slices"
      "Math": "Neither operand is decoded. For packed codes ac, bc and E4M3 scales\
        \ as, bs over a reduction length L that is a multiple of nvfp4_block, with\
        \ kb = floor(k/nvfp4_block):\n  bsprod(ac,as,bc,bs)[m,n] = sum32 over kb ascending\
        \ of fp32(as[m,kb]) * fp32(bs[n,kb]) * sum_{u=0}^{nvfp4_block-1} e2m1(ac[m,kb*nvfp4_block+u])\
        \ * e2m1(bc[n,kb*nvfp4_block+u])\nthe FP32 accumulator being zeroed before\
        \ kb = 0; one instruction advances nvfp4_block*4 channels, inner sum and scale\
        \ products included.\nThe FC1 reduction splits into split_count slices of\
        \ hidden_dim/split_count channels.\nFor tile j, slice sl and n-tile channels\
        \ n, part[sl,r,n] is bsprod over slice sl of the row r activation operand\
        \ against prepared row n of expert tile_expert[j], and part[sl,r,intermediate_dim+n]\
        \ the same against row intermediate_dim+n, written only below tile_rows(j).\n\
        For the (t,s) with route_of[t,s] = r, the ascending sum over sl of part[sl,r,n]\
        \ is the Contract's up[t,s,n] and of the gate column its gate[t,s,n].\n"
      "Symbol":
        "split_count":
          "meaning": "Channel slices of the FC1 hidden reduction"
          "value": 2
        "part":
          "meaning": "FP32 slice partial of the up and gate of one route"
          "shape":
          - "slice": "split_count"
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          - "channel": "2*intermediate_dim"
          "dtype": "fp32"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
      "Arithmetic":
        "Accumulate": "FP32 accumulator, ascending block order, zeroed at the item's\
          \ first group; each slice keeps its own, added in ascending slice order\
          \ downstream"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "One item per (tile, n-tile) accumulating all hidden_dim/256 stages\
          \ in one accumulator and quantizing it in place"
        "Gain": "Items tile_count*(intermediate_dim/64) -> split_count times that,\
          \ each accumulator chain hidden_dim/256 -> hidden_dim/(256*split_count)\
          \ stages"
        "Cost": "0 -> split_count*route_capacity*2*intermediate_dim FP32 partial elements\
          \ written once and read once"
    - "Name": "Slice reduction of the FC1 partials"
      "Math": "For a route r, a group b of nvfp4_block consecutive intermediate channels\
        \ and a channel u of that group:\n  fc1_up = the sum over sl ascending of\
        \ part[sl,r,b*nvfp4_block+u], from 0\n  fc1_gate = the sum over sl ascending\
        \ of part[sl,r,intermediate_dim+b*nvfp4_block+u], from 0\nso the slice sums\
        \ cover the hidden reduction in ascending channel order, joined by split_count-1\
        \ FP32 adds per element.\nThe reduction ranges over all route_capacity rows.\
        \ Rows at or past route_count are produced by no item and hold what part kept:\
        \ their route_expert is outside [0,expert_count) and they are dropped, or\
        \ it is a stale in-range id and their activation bytes land in a row no fc2\
        \ tile stores.\n"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "One accumulator per route holding the whole hidden reduction,\
          \ quantized by the epilogue that produced it"
        "Cost": "0 -> split_count*route_capacity*2*intermediate_dim*4 bytes of FP32\
          \ partials read once, and split_count-1 extra FP32 adds per element"
    - "Name": "Clamp, activation and NVFP4 quantize"
      "Math": "For route r, e = route_expert[r], alpha = gemm1_alpha[e], beta = gemm1_beta[e],\
        \ limit = gemm1_clamp_limit[e] when present:\n  gate_c = min(fc1_gate, limit),\
        \ up_c = min(max(fc1_up,-limit),limit) when present, else both unchanged\n\
        \  activation_type 3:  act = (gate_c * sig(alpha*gate_c)) * (up_c + beta)\n\
        \  activation_type 10: act = (alpha * tanh(rcp_rn(alpha)*gate_c)) * sig(gate_c)\
        \ * (beta * tanh(rcp_rn(beta)*up_c))\n  sig(x) = rcp_approx(1 + exp2_approx_ftz(x*L2E));\
        \ tanh(x) = fma32(sig(2*x),2,-1); L2E = fp32(-1.44269504)\nPer group b of\
        \ nvfp4_block channels of one route, peak = max abs(act) over the group, an\
        \ order-free tree across its four quarters:\n  act_scale[r,b] = fp8_e4m3fn(min(peak\
        \ * fp32(1/e2m1_max), e4m3_max)), saturating\n  act_code = e2m1_rne(act *\
        \ rcp_rn(max(fp32(act_scale[r,b]), 2^-126))), saturating\nact_payload packs\
        \ two act_code per byte with the even channel in the low nibble, so act_code*fp32(act_scale)\
        \ is the Contract's act_q.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "act_scale":
          "meaning": "E4M3 scale of one activation block"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          - "block": "intermediate_dim/nvfp4_block"
          "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
        "act_payload":
          "meaning": "E2M1 activation codes at two per byte"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          - "packed": "intermediate_dim/2"
          "dtype": "uint8"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
      "Arithmetic":
        "Approx": "sig and tanh use ex2.approx.ftz and rcp.approx; their non-folded\
          \ prescales differ from root, and source comments give no domain-wide bound"
        "Accumulate": "peak is an order-free max tree; the quantize multiplies by\
          \ rcp_rn of the scale instead of dividing, and 1/e2m1_max is a rounded constant"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Clamp, activate and quantize in the GEMM1 epilogue from the item's\
          \ own accumulator"
        "Gain": "One pass over route_capacity*(intermediate_dim/nvfp4_block) groups\
          \ with four threads each, not a drain inside a tile epilogue"
        "Cost": "Every activation argument is scaled by two rounded multiplies instead\
          \ of one folded constant"
    - "Name": "Fc2 product and per-route BF16"
      "Math": "fc2[r,h] = bsprod of row r of (act_payload, act_scale) against the\
        \ prepared row h of expert tile_expert[j] in (gemm2_weights, gemm2_weights_scale),\
        \ with L = intermediate_dim, for the routes r of tile j. For the (t,s) with\
        \ route_of[t,s] = r it is the Contract's inner sum of that route, because\
        \ act_code*fp32(act_scale) is act_q.\nrout[r,h] = bf16(fc2[r,h]), round to\
        \ nearest even, is materialized for every valid route and is what the routing\
        \ reduction consumes; fc2 itself is never stored.\nA padding row can read\
        \ a later expert's valid act_payload row, an ACT-produced or unwritten tail\
        \ row, or zero fill beyond route_capacity. Its scales repeat this tile's first\
        \ valid row. GEMM2 discards that row's result; it never overwrites a later\
        \ expert's rout row.\n"
      "Symbol":
        "rout":
          "meaning": "Per-route FC2 result as BF16"
          "shape":
          - "route": "route_capacity"
          - "hidden": "hidden_dim"
          "dtype": "bf16"
          "retention": "keep_value invocation"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Keep each route's FC2 result in FP32, or reduce routes into the\
          \ token output where they are produced"
        "Gain": "Route result bytes 4 -> 2 per element"
        "Cost": "One extra BF16 rounding per element, and route_capacity*hidden_dim*2\
          \ bytes written then re-read"
    - "Name": "Routing-weighted output reduction"
      "Math": "For every token t and hidden channel h:\n  acc[t,h] = the sum over\
        \ s ascending of fma32(fp32(rout[route_of[t,s],h]), scores[t,s], partial),\
        \ from 0\nskipping every s whose route_of[t,s] is -1, so an invalid route\
        \ contributes exactly 0; output[t,h] = bf16(acc[t,h]).\nThese are the Contract's\
        \ acc and output with the route sum fixed to ascending slot order, which the\
        \ Contract leaves unspecified. fp32(x) is the exact widening of a BF16 value,\
        \ and output is written for every (t,h) whether or not any route is valid.\n"
      "Arithmetic":
        "Accumulate": "Each route term is one fma32 of the widened BF16 value and\
          \ its score, so the product is not rounded before the running sum"
      "Ledger":
        "Baseline": "Accumulate the score-weighted route results into the output atomically,\
          \ as the reference does"
        "Gain": "A fixed ascending slot order per element, one BF16 rounding, and\
          \ no read-modify-write of output"
        "Cost": "rout is read slot_count times per token instead of being reduced\
          \ where it is produced"
  "Work_schedule":
    "Thesis": "One submission per node, each free to launch at its predecessor's permission\
      \ rather than its completion, so preambles overlap. One block builds the routing\
      \ map; both GEMMs read it through a persistent capped grid; FC1 items are (tile,\
      \ slice, n-tile), doubling the workers feeding the activation node"
    "Step":
      "PREPARE":
        "Describe": "Build the whole routing map in one block: expert counts, route\
          \ and tile offsets, every route's position and tuple, and the tile map"
        "Decomposition":
          "Strategy": "32 warp ranges over the route list; warp-private histograms,\
            \ a cross-warp prefix per expert and a 32-warp scan publish counts and\
            \ both offsets"
          "Partition": {}
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "counts":
                "meaning": "Valid routes per expert"
                "shape":
                - "expert": "expert_count"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "offs":
                "meaning": "Exclusive route prefix per expert"
                "shape":
                - "expert": "expert_count+1"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "tile_offsets":
                "meaning": "Exclusive tile prefix per expert"
                "shape":
                - "expert": "expert_count+1"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "tile_expert":
                "meaning": "Expert owning each route tile"
                "shape":
                - "tile": "tile_count"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "tile_first":
                "meaning": "First route of a tile inside its expert"
                "shape":
                - "tile": "tile_count"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "route_of":
                "meaning": "Position of each route slot"
                "shape":
                - "token": "token_count"
                - "slot": "slot_count"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "route_token":
                "meaning": "Token of each positioned route"
                "shape":
                - "route": "route_capacity"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "route_slot":
                "meaning": "Slot of each positioned route"
                "shape":
                - "route": "route_capacity"
                "dtype": "int32"
              "route_expert":
                "meaning": "Expert of each positioned route"
                "shape":
                - "route": "route_capacity"
                "dtype": "int32"
        "Mapping":
          "Strategy": "One block of 1024 threads; the staged ids, histogram, scan\
            \ and positions stay in shared memory, whose dynamic part is sized by\
            \ route_capacity"
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1
          "Worker_count": 1
        "Schedule":
          "Worker_assignment":
            "Preassigned":
              "start": 0
              "count": 1
            "Refill": "none"
            "Exit": "assigned_done"
      "GEMM1":
        "Describe": "Multiply each route tile's activation rows of one channel slice\
          \ by its expert's FC1 weight and store the raw FP32 slice partials of both\
          \ halves"
        "Decomposition":
          "Strategy": "bm = 128 route rows per tile; split_count slices cut the hidden_dim/256\
            \ stages evenly, so hidden_dim/256 is a multiple of it; a stage is 256\
            \ channels"
          "Partition":
            "tile":
              "meaning": "One existing route tile"
              "size": "tile_count"
              "tile": 1
              "range":
              - 0
              - "tile_bound"
            "k_slice":
              "meaning": "One channel slice of the hidden reduction"
              "size": "split_count"
              "tile": 1
            "n_tile":
              "meaning": "Block of intermediate channels"
              "size": "intermediate_dim"
              "tile": 64
          "Worktile":
            "Iteration":
              "a_payload":
                "meaning": "Activation payload rows fetched for this stage"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "byte": 128
                "dtype": "uint8"
                "direction": "ascending"
              "a_scale":
                "meaning": "Activation scales of the same fetched rows"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "scale_block": 16
                "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
                "direction": "ascending"
              "b_payload":
                "meaning": "FC1 payload of 128 prepared rows; up then gate"
                "shape":
                - "row": 128
                - "byte": 128
                "dtype": "uint8"
                "direction": "ascending"
              "b_scale":
                "meaning": "FC1 scales of those rows in one fused image"
                "shape":
                - "row": 128
                - "scale_block": 16
                "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
                "direction": "ascending"
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "part":
                "meaning": "FP32 slice partials of this item's columns"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "channel": 128
                "dtype": "fp32"
        "Mapping":
          "Strategy": "resident_cap is two CTAs per sm of the device; the capped grid\
            \ only partitions items and never changes which items run"
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1
          "Worker_count": "items_per_tile*min(tile_bound, max(1, floor(resident_cap/items_per_tile)))"
        "Schedule":
          "Strategy": "items_per_tile = split_count*(intermediate_dim/64); items number\
            \ tile*items_per_tile + k_slice*(intermediate_dim/64) + n_tile, bounded\
            \ by tile_count"
          "Worktile_order":
          - "by": "tile"
            "direction": "ascending"
          - "by": "k_slice"
            "direction": "ascending"
          - "by": "n_tile"
            "direction": "ascending"
          "Worker_assignment":
            "Preassigned":
              "start": "worker_id"
              "stride": "worker_count"
            "Refill": "none"
            "Exit": "assigned_done"
      "ACT":
        "Describe": "Reduce the FP32 slice partials of every route block in ascending\
          \ slice order, then clamp, activate and quantize them into the packed activation"
        "Decomposition":
          "Strategy": "One thread per quarter of a 16-channel block of a route, quarters\
            \ fastest; the four threads of a block share its maximum and one writes\
            \ its scale byte"
          "Partition":
            "act_item":
              "meaning": "One quarter of a route's activation block"
              "size": "route_capacity*(intermediate_dim/nvfp4_block)*4"
              "tile": 256
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "act_payload":
                "meaning": "Packed activation codes of this worktile"
                "shape":
                - "block": 64
                - "byte": 8
                "dtype": "uint8"
              "act_scale":
                "meaning": "Group scale of those 64 route blocks"
                "shape":
                - "block": 64
                "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
            "Tile_reduction":
              "dimension": "k_slice"
              "input": "ref:DESIGN.Math_reshape::part"
              "output":
              - "ref:DESIGN.Math_reshape::act_payload"
              - "ref:DESIGN.Math_reshape::act_scale"
              "method": "ref:DESIGN.Math_reshape::Slice reduction of the FC1 partials"
        "Mapping":
          "Strategy": "One thread per item with no grid stride; a thread whose item\
            \ index passes route_capacity*(intermediate_dim/nvfp4_block)*4 has no\
            \ work"
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1
          "Worker_count": "ceil_div(route_capacity*(intermediate_dim/nvfp4_block)*4,\
            \ 256)"
        "Schedule":
          "Worktile_order":
          - "by": "act_item"
            "direction": "ascending"
          "Worker_assignment":
            "Preassigned":
              "start": "worker_id"
              "count": 1
            "Refill": "none"
            "Exit": "assigned_done"
      "GEMM2":
        "Describe": "Multiply each route tile's packed activation by its expert's\
          \ FC2 weight and materialize every route's result as BF16"
        "Decomposition":
          "Strategy": "bm = 128 route rows per tile, the same tiles GEMM1 used; a\
            \ stage advances 256 intermediate channels of one 128-column operand"
          "Partition":
            "tile":
              "meaning": "One existing route tile"
              "size": "tile_count"
              "tile": 1
              "range":
              - 0
              - "tile_bound"
            "n_tile":
              "meaning": "Block of hidden channels"
              "size": "hidden_dim"
              "tile": 128
          "Worktile":
            "Iteration":
              "a_payload":
                "meaning": "Packed activation payload of the tile rows"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "byte": 128
                "dtype": "uint8"
                "direction": "ascending"
              "a_scale":
                "meaning": "Activation group scales of the tile rows"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "scale_block": 16
                "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
                "direction": "ascending"
              "b_payload":
                "meaning": "FC2 payload of 128 prepared rows"
                "shape":
                - "row": 128
                - "byte": 128
                "dtype": "uint8"
                "direction": "ascending"
              "b_scale":
                "meaning": "FC2 scales of those prepared rows"
                "shape":
                - "row": 128
                - "scale_block": 16
                "dtype": "fp8_e4m3fn"
                "direction": "ascending"
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "rout":
                "meaning": "BF16 route results of the tile"
                "shape":
                - "route": "bm"
                - "hidden": 128
                "dtype": "bf16"
        "Mapping":
          "Strategy": "resident_cap is two CTAs per sm of the device; the capped grid\
            \ only partitions items and never changes which items run"
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1
          "Worker_count": "(hidden_dim/128)*min(tile_bound, max(1, floor(resident_cap/(hidden_dim/128))))"
        "Schedule":
          "Strategy": "Items number tile*(hidden_dim/128) + n_tile, bounded by the\
            \ device tile_count; the leaf is fixed by the ids of the launch-setting\
            \ call"
          "Worktile_order":
          - "by": "tile"
            "direction": "ascending"
          - "by": "n_tile"
            "direction": "ascending"
          "Worker_assignment":
            "Preassigned":
              "start": "worker_id"
              "stride": "worker_count"
            "Refill": "none"
            "Exit": "assigned_done"
      "FINALIZE":
        "Describe": "Sum each token's routed BF16 results weighted by their routing\
          \ scores and write that token's output row"
        "Decomposition":
          "Partition":
            "token":
              "meaning": "One output row"
              "size": "token_count"
              "tile": 1
            "hidden_block":
              "meaning": "Block of hidden channels"
              "size": "hidden_dim"
              "tile": 512
          "Target":
            "Single_tile":
              "output":
                "meaning": "This token's channels in the block"
                "shape":
                - "hidden": 512
                "dtype": "ref:CONTRACT.Algorithm_requirement::output.dtype"
        "Mapping":
          "Strategy": "One thread per 4-channel chunk of the block; a thread whose\
            \ chunk passes hidden_dim/4 has no work"
          "Worker":
            "unit": "cta"
            "unit_count": 1
          "Worker_count": "token_count * ceil_div(hidden_dim, 512)"
        "Schedule":
          "Worktile_order":
          - "by": "token"
            "direction": "ascending"
          - "by": "hidden_block"
            "direction": "ascending"
          "Worker_assignment":
            "Preassigned":
              "start": "worker_id"
              "count": 1
            "Refill": "none"
            "Exit": "assigned_done"
    "Flow":

      - "step":
        - "PREPARE"
      - "step":

        "route_token":

  "Tile_pipeline":
    "Thesis": "Both GEMMs split seven warps into two operand producers, one tensor-core\
      \ issuer and four epilogue warps coupled only by mbarriers, with a three-deep\
      \ payload ring, a two-deep scale ring and one accumulator per item; the boundary\
      \ hoist stays off in this range. The other three nodes are single roles"
    "Step":
      "PREPARE":
        "Storage":
          "ids_stage":
            "meaning": "Staged expert id of every route slot"
            "depth": 1
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "route": "route_capacity"
            "dtype": "int32"
            "total_size": "4*route_capacity"
          "warp_table":
            "meaning": "Warp-private per-expert counters and bases"
            "depth": 1
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "warp": 32
            - "expert": 256
            "dtype": "int32"
            "total_size": 32768
        "Role":
          "MAIN":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Build the routing map and the tile map of the whole call\
                \ in one block"
              "Member": "warp[0:32]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "stage_ids":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Read the route_capacity ids into ids_stage, 16 bytes\
                      \ at a time where the pointer allows it, and zero warp_table;\
                      \ done covers the block rendezvous"
                  "histogram":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Each warp counts the valid ids of its own contiguous\
                      \ route range into its warp_table row; done covers the block\
                      \ rendezvous"
                  "expert_scan":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Publish counts from each expert column of warp_table\
                      \ turned into per-warp bases, then scan them into offs and tile_offsets;\
                      \ done covers the rendezvous"
                  "scatter":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Take each position from its warp base and the per-expert\
                      \ rank, then write route_token, route_slot, route_expert and\
                      \ route_of, or -1 when invalid"
                  "tile_map":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Search the shared tile offsets for every tile of\
                      \ the call and write tile_expert and tile_first"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait until every prior submission has completed\
                      \ and flushed its writes; done covers the whole CTA"
                "signal":
                  "launch_dependents":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One warp per CTA permits the successor submission\
                      \ to launch; the grid signals once every CTA has run it"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "signal:launch_dependents"
            - "compute:stage_ids"
            - "compute:histogram"
            - "compute:expert_scan"
            - "compute:scatter"
            - "compute:tile_map"
      "GEMM1":
        "Index":
          "t":
            "meaning": "Local ordinal of this worker's items"
            "definition": "worktile"
          "ks":
            "meaning": "k stage inside one item"
            "definition":
            - 0
            - "hidden_dim/(256*split_count)"
          "g":
            "meaning": "Stage ordinal across items"
            "definition":
              "flatten":
              - "t"
              - "ks"
        "Storage":
          "a_ring":
            "meaning": "Staged activation payload rows of one stage"
            "depth": 3
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "route": 128
            - "byte": 128
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 49152
            "view":
              "a_payload(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%3"
          "b_ring":
            "meaning": "FC1 payload stages; up rows then gate rows"
            "depth": 3
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "row": 128
            - "byte": 128
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 49152
            "view":
              "b_payload(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%3"
          "sfa_ring":
            "meaning": "Staged activation scale blocks"
            "depth": 2
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "element": 2048
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 4096
            "view":
              "a_scale(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"
          "sfb_ring":
            "meaning": "Staged fused weight scale blocks"
            "depth": 2
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "element": 2048
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 4096
            "view":
              "b_scale(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"
          "sf_tmem":
            "meaning": "Tensor-core scale columns of one stage"
            "depth": 2
            "location": "tmem"
            "shape":
            - "row": 128
            - "column": 32
            "dtype": "fp32"
            "total_size": 32768
            "view":
              "sf_a(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"
                "region":
                  "column":
                  - 0
                  - 16
              "sf_b(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"
                "region":
                  "column":
                  - 16
                  - 32
          "accumulator":
            "meaning": "FP32 up and gate slice partial of one item"
            "depth": 1
            "location": "tmem"
            "shape":
            - "route": 128
            - "column": 128
            "dtype": "fp32"
            "total_size": 65536
          "sf_prefetch":
            "meaning": "Lookahead register set of activation scale rows"
            "depth": 2
            "location": "register"
            "shape":
            - "lane": 32
            - "row": 4
            - "byte": 16
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 4096
            "view":
              "sf_regs(ks)":
                "slot_index": "ks%2"
        "Role":
          "PRODA":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Stage the activation scale bytes of every stage into the\
                \ scale ring one stage ahead of their use, fetching only the tile's\
                \ valid route rows"
              "Member": "warp[0:1]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "setup":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Thread 0 initializes the ring and item barriers with\
                      \ their arrival counts and warp 0 allocates the TMEM columns;\
                      \ done covers the CTA rendezvous"
                  "sfa_stage":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Store the fetched rows into the sfa slot and fence\
                      \ it, clipped rows keep the slot's prior bytes, issue the next\
                      \ stage's load unless last, then arrive"
                "load":
                  "sf_rows":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Prime both sf_prefetch sets with this item's first\
                      \ two stages, 16 bytes per row, from the hidden_states_scale\
                      \ rows route_token names below tile_rows"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait every warp of the CTA runs before\
                      \ the roles diverge; done covers this role reaching it"
                  "scale_slot_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the tensor-core scale copy of stage g-2\
                      \ has read the sfa slot that g reuses"
                  "retire":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "CTA-wide rendezvous after the last item; done covers\
                      \ every role having reached it"
                "signal":
                  "launch_dependents":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One warp per CTA permits the successor submission\
                      \ to launch; the grid signals once every CTA has run it"
                "release":
                  "tmem":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Warp 0 returns the allocated TMEM columns once the\
                      \ retire rendezvous has closed every role's reads"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "signal:launch_dependents"
            - "if(worktile_count > 0)":
              - "compute:setup"
              - "for(t)":
                - "load:sf_rows(t)"
                - "for(g[t])":
                  - "if(g >= 2)":
                    - "await:scale_slot_free(g)"
                  - "compute:sfa_stage(g)"
              - "await:retire"
              - "release:tmem"
            "Waiting":
              "Released":
              - "{done await:scale_slot_free(g)} ← [{done MMA::signal:stage_retired(g-2)}]"
              - "{issue release:tmem} ← [{done PRODB::await:retire}, {done MMA::await:retire},\
                \ {done EPI::await:retire}]"
          "PRODB":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Stage operand payloads by bulk tensor copy, the activation\
                \ rows by clipped four-row gather boxes, and the weight scales by\
                \ async copies"
              "Member": "warp[1:2]"
              "Using_verb":
                "load":
                  "a_payload":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Lane 0 arms the barrier with (128 + 4*nbox) 128-byte\
                      \ rows, nbox = max(1, min(32, ceil(tile_rows(j)/4))); lanes\
                      \ below nbox gather four rows each"
                  "b_payload":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Lane 0 issues two 64-row boxes over the prepared\
                      \ FC1 weight of tile_expert, the up half then the gate half,\
                      \ into one b_ring slot"
                  "b_scale":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "All 32 lanes copy this stage's weight scale bytes\
                      \ into the sfb slot as one fused 128-row image and arm their\
                      \ arrival; done covers the staged bytes"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait every warp of the CTA runs before\
                      \ the roles diverge; done covers this role reaching it"
                  "setup":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Take part in the CTA rendezvous that follows barrier\
                      \ initialization and TMEM allocation"
                  "payload_slot_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the tensor-core products of stage g-3\
                      \ have read the payload slots that g reuses"
                  "scale_slot_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the tensor-core scale copy of stage g-2\
                      \ has read the sfb slot that g reuses"
                  "retire":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "CTA-wide rendezvous after the last item; done covers\
                      \ every role having reached it"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "if(worktile_count > 0)":
              - "await:setup"
              - "for(t)":
                - "for(g[t])":
                  - "if(g >= 3)":
                    - "await:payload_slot_free(g)"
                  - "load:a_payload(g)"
                  - "load:b_payload(g)"
                  - "if(g >= 2)":
                    - "await:scale_slot_free(g)"
                  - "load:b_scale(g)"
              - "await:retire"
            "Waiting":
              "Prepared":
              - "{done await:setup} ← [{done PRODA::compute:setup}]"
              "Released":
              - "{done await:payload_slot_free(g)} ← [{done MMA::signal:stage_retired(g-3)}]"
              - "{done await:scale_slot_free(g)} ← [{done MMA::signal:stage_retired(g-2)}]"
          "MMA":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Copy each stage's scales into TMEM and issue the fused\
                \ block-scaled products of this item's channel slice"
              "Member": "warp[2:3]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "sf_tmem":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One elected lane copies this stage's activation and\
                      \ weight scale blocks from shared memory into the sf_tmem columns\
                      \ of slot g%2"
                "matmul":
                  "a_payload@b_payload":
                    "execution_mode": "async_ordered"
                    "describe": "Four products of a_ring g%3 and b_ring g%3 with sf_a(g),\
                      \ sf_b(g); the item's first writes the accumulator, the rest\
                      \ add, so it holds a slice partial"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait every warp of the CTA runs before\
                      \ the roles diverge; done covers this role reaching it"
                  "setup":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Take part in the CTA rendezvous that follows barrier\
                      \ initialization and TMEM allocation"
                  "stage_full":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the stage barrier of g has the fetched\
                      \ activation rows, both weight payload boxes, both scale blocks\
                      \ and all producer arrivals"
                  "accumulator_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until all four epilogue warps have released\
                      \ the accumulator of item t-1, so this item may overwrite it"
                  "retire":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "CTA-wide rendezvous after the last item; done covers\
                      \ every role having reached it"
                "signal":
                  "stage_retired":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Commit all products issued so far; the arrival retires\
                      \ stage g, freeing its payload slot and, cumulatively, its scale\
                      \ slot"
                  "accumulator_full":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Commit at the item's end; the arrival means every\
                      \ product of item t has retired and the slice partial is readable"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "if(worktile_count > 0)":
              - "await:setup"
              - "for(t)":
                - "if(t > 0)":
                  - "await:accumulator_free(t)"
                - "for(g[t])":
                  - "await:stage_full(g)"
                  - "compute:sf_tmem(g)"
                  - "matmul:a_payload(g)@b_payload(g)"
                  - "signal:stage_retired(g)"
                - "signal:accumulator_full(t)"
              - "await:retire"
            "Waiting":
              "Prepared":
              - "{done await:setup} ← [{done PRODA::compute:setup}]"
              - "{done await:stage_full(g)} ← [{done PRODA::compute:sfa_stage(g)},\
                \ {done PRODB::load:a_payload(g)}, {done PRODB::load:b_payload(g)},\
                \ {done PRODB::load:b_scale(g)}]"
              - "{done signal:stage_retired(g)} ← [{done matmul:a_payload(g)@b_payload(g)}]"
              "Released":
              - "{done await:accumulator_free(t)} ← [{done EPI::signal:accumulator_free(t-1)}]"
          "EPI":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Drain the item's accumulator by row quadrant and store\
                \ its raw FP32 slice partials"
              "Member": "warp[3:7]"
              "Using_verb":
                "load":
                  "tmem_up":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Read 32 accumulator columns of the up half for this\
                      \ warp's 32 rows into registers"
                  "tmem_gate":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Read the matching 32 columns of the gate half into\
                      \ registers"
                "store":
                  "part":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Write this chunk's 32 up and 32 gate FP32 values\
                      \ per lane into slice k_slice of part at the item's columns;\
                      \ lanes past tile_rows(j) write nothing"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait every warp of the CTA runs before\
                      \ the roles diverge; done covers this role reaching it"
                  "setup":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Take part in the CTA rendezvous that follows barrier\
                      \ initialization and TMEM allocation"
                  "accumulator_full":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the products of item t have retired and\
                      \ the accumulator is readable by all four warps"
                  "tmem_drain":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait for this chunk's two 32-column accumulator reads,\
                      \ the up half and the gate half, issued back to back"
                  "retire":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "CTA-wide rendezvous after the last item; done covers\
                      \ every role having reached it"
                "signal":
                  "accumulator_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Each of the four warps arrives once both of its chunk\
                      \ reads and both of its partial stores have been issued; the\
                      \ global writes may still be in flight"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "if(worktile_count > 0)":
              - "await:setup"
              - "for(t)":
                - "await:accumulator_full(t)"
                - "for(c=0:2)":
                  - "load:tmem_up(t,c)"
                  - "load:tmem_gate(t,c)"
                  - "await:tmem_drain(t,c)"
                  - "store:part(t,c)"
                - "signal:accumulator_free(t)"
              - "await:retire"
            "Waiting":
              "Prepared":

      "ACT":
        "Role":
          "MAIN":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Reduce the slice partials of one quarter of one 16-channel\
                \ activation block and write that block's packed codes and scale"
              "Member": "warp[0:8]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "act_qdq":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Sum the loaded slices ascending, then clamp, activate\
                      \ and quantize four channels by the Math_reshape step, sharing\
                      \ the group maximum by shuffle"
                "load":
                  "partials":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Issue 2*split_count float4 loads, one up and one\
                      \ gate vector per slice, for this thread's four channels before\
                      \ the expert lookup; done covers them"
                  "route_expert":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Read route_expert of this thread's route row and\
                      \ set expert_valid when it lies in [0,expert_count)"
                "store":
                  "act_payload":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "The lanes holding quarter 0 or 2 of a block write\
                      \ one 4-byte word holding their own four codes and the next\
                      \ quarter's four"
                  "act_scale":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "The lane holding quarter 0 of a block writes that\
                      \ block's scale byte"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait until every prior submission has completed\
                      \ and flushed its writes; done covers the whole CTA"
                "signal":
                  "launch_dependents":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One warp per CTA permits the successor submission\
                      \ to launch; the grid signals once every CTA has run it"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "signal:launch_dependents"
            - "load:partials"
            - "load:route_expert"
            - "if(expert_valid)":
              - "compute:act_qdq"
              - "store:act_payload"
              - "store:act_scale"
            "Waiting":
              "Prepared":
              - "{issue compute:act_qdq} ← [{done load:partials}]"
      "GEMM2":
        "Index":
          "t":
            "meaning": "Local ordinal of this worker's items"
            "definition": "worktile"
          "ks":
            "meaning": "k stage inside one item"
            "definition":
            - 0
            - "intermediate_dim/256"
          "g":
            "meaning": "Stage ordinal across items"
            "definition":
              "flatten":
              - "t"
              - "ks"
        "Storage":
          "a_ring":
            "meaning": "Packed activation payload stages"
            "depth": 3
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "route": 128
            - "byte": 128
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 49152
            "view":
              "a_payload(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%3"
          "b_ring":
            "meaning": "FC2 payload stages"
            "depth": 3
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "row": 128
            - "byte": 128
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 49152
            "view":
              "b_payload(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%3"
          "sfa_ring":
            "meaning": "Staged activation scale blocks"
            "depth": 2
            "location": "smem"
            "shape":
            - "element": 2048
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 4096
            "view":
              "a_scale(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"
          "sfb_ring":
            "meaning": "Staged weight scale blocks"

            - "element": 2048
            "dtype": "uint8"
            "total_size": 4096
            "view":
              "b_scale(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"

            - "column": 32

            "total_size": 32768
            "view":
              "sf_a(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"
                "region":
                  "column":
                  - 0
                  - 16
              "sf_b(g)":
                "slot_index": "g%2"
                "region":
                  "column":
                  - 16
                  - 32
          "accumulator":
            "meaning": "FP32 hidden product of one item"
            "depth": 1
            "location": "tmem"
            "shape":
            - "route": 128
            - "column": 128
            "dtype": "fp32"
            "total_size": 65536

            "meaning": "Lookahead register set of activation scale rows"
            "depth": 2

        "Role":
          "PRODA":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Stage the activation scale bytes of every stage into the\
                \ scale ring one stage ahead of their use"
              "Member": "warp[0:1]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "setup":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Thread 0 initializes the ring and item barriers with\
                      \ their arrival counts and warp 0 allocates the TMEM columns;\
                      \ done covers the CTA rendezvous"
                  "sfa_stage":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Store the register set into the sfa slot and fence\
                      \ it, issue the next stage's load unless this is the item's\
                      \ last, then arrive on the stage barrier"
                "load":
                  "sf_rows":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Prime min(2,intermediate_dim/256) stages in sf_prefetch\
                      \ from act_scale, 16 bytes per row; padding rows repeat the\
                      \ tile's first valid scale row"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait every warp of the CTA runs before\
                      \ the roles diverge; done covers this role reaching it"
                  "scale_slot_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the tensor-core scale copy of stage g-2\
                      \ has read the sfa slot that g reuses"
                  "retire":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "CTA-wide rendezvous after the last item; done covers\
                      \ every role having reached it"
                "signal":
                  "launch_dependents":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One warp per CTA permits the successor submission\
                      \ to launch; the grid signals once every CTA has run it"
                "release":
                  "tmem":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Warp 0 returns the allocated TMEM columns once the\
                      \ retire rendezvous has closed every role's reads"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "signal:launch_dependents"
            - "if(worktile_count > 0)":
              - "compute:setup"
              - "for(t)":
                - "load:sf_rows(t)"
                - "for(g[t])":
                  - "if(g >= 2)":
                    - "await:scale_slot_free(g)"
                  - "compute:sfa_stage(g)"
              - "await:retire"
              - "release:tmem"
            "Waiting":
              "Released":
              - "{done await:scale_slot_free(g)} ← [{done MMA::signal:stage_retired(g-2)}]"
              - "{issue release:tmem} ← [{done PRODB::await:retire}, {done MMA::await:retire},\
                \ {done EPI::await:retire}]"
          "PRODB":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Stage each stage's operand payloads by bulk tensor copy\
                \ and its weight scales by async chunk copies"
              "Member": "warp[1:2]"
              "Using_verb":
                "load":
                  "a_payload":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Lane 0 arms the stage barrier with both operands'\
                      \ byte count and issues one 128-row box from act_payload, padding\
                      \ rows included"
                  "b_payload":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Lane 0 issues one 128-row box over the prepared FC2\
                      \ weight of tile_expert into b_ring"
                  "b_scale":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "All 32 lanes copy this stage's weight scale bytes\
                      \ into the sfb slot and arm their arrival on the stage barrier;\
                      \ done covers the staged bytes"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait every warp of the CTA runs before\
                      \ the roles diverge; done covers this role reaching it"
                  "setup":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Take part in the CTA rendezvous that follows barrier\
                      \ initialization and TMEM allocation"
                  "payload_slot_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the tensor-core products of stage g-3\
                      \ have read the payload slots that g reuses"
                  "scale_slot_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the tensor-core scale copy of stage g-2\
                      \ has read the sfb slot that g reuses"
                  "retire":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "CTA-wide rendezvous after the last item; done covers\
                      \ every role having reached it"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "if(worktile_count > 0)":
              - "await:setup"
              - "for(t)":
                - "for(g[t])":
                  - "if(g >= 3)":
                    - "await:payload_slot_free(g)"
                  - "load:a_payload(g)"
                  - "load:b_payload(g)"
                  - "if(g >= 2)":
                    - "await:scale_slot_free(g)"
                  - "load:b_scale(g)"
              - "await:retire"
            "Waiting":
              "Prepared":
              - "{done await:setup} ← [{done PRODA::compute:setup}]"
              "Released":
              - "{done await:payload_slot_free(g)} ← [{done MMA::signal:stage_retired(g-3)}]"
              - "{done await:scale_slot_free(g)} ← [{done MMA::signal:stage_retired(g-2)}]"
          "MMA":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Copy each stage's scales into TMEM and issue the block-scaled\
                \ products; the boundary hoist stays off here as route_capacity <\
                \ 16*expert_count"
              "Member": "warp[2:3]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "sf_tmem":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One elected lane copies this stage's activation and\
                      \ weight scale blocks from shared memory into the sf_tmem columns\
                      \ of slot g%2"
                "matmul":
                  "a_payload@b_payload":
                    "execution_mode": "async_ordered"
                    "describe": "Four products of a_ring g%3, b_ring g%3 with sf_a(g),\
                      \ sf_b(g); the item's first writes the accumulator without reading\
                      \ the prior value, the rest add"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait every warp of the CTA runs before\
                      \ the roles diverge; done covers this role reaching it"
                  "setup":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Take part in the CTA rendezvous that follows barrier\
                      \ initialization and TMEM allocation"
                  "stage_full":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the stage barrier of g has both operand\
                      \ payloads, both scale blocks and all producer arrivals"
                  "accumulator_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until all four epilogue warps have released\
                      \ the accumulator of item t-1, so this item may overwrite it"
                  "retire":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "CTA-wide rendezvous after the last item; done covers\
                      \ every role having reached it"
                "signal":
                  "stage_retired":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Commit all products issued so far; the arrival retires\
                      \ stage g, freeing its payload slot and, cumulatively, its scale\
                      \ slot"
                  "accumulator_full":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Commit at the item's end; the arrival means every\
                      \ product of item t has retired and the accumulator is readable"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "if(worktile_count > 0)":
              - "await:setup"
              - "for(t)":
                - "if(t > 0)":
                  - "await:accumulator_free(t)"
                - "for(g[t])":
                  - "await:stage_full(g)"
                  - "compute:sf_tmem(g)"
                  - "matmul:a_payload(g)@b_payload(g)"
                  - "signal:stage_retired(g)"
                - "signal:accumulator_full(t)"
              - "await:retire"
            "Waiting":
              "Prepared":
              - "{done await:setup} ← [{done PRODA::compute:setup}]"
              - "{done await:stage_full(g)} ← [{done PRODA::compute:sfa_stage(g)},\
                \ {done PRODB::load:a_payload(g)}, {done PRODB::load:b_payload(g)},\
                \ {done PRODB::load:b_scale(g)}]"
              - "{done signal:stage_retired(g)} ← [{done matmul:a_payload(g)@b_payload(g)}]"
              "Released":
              - "{done await:accumulator_free(t)} ← [{done EPI::signal:accumulator_free(t-1)}]"
          "EPI":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Drain the item's accumulator by row quadrant in pairs and\
                \ write each valid route's BF16 result"
              "Member": "warp[3:7]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "rout_bf16":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Round this chunk's 32 accumulators to BF16 nearest\
                      \ even in registers, one rout element per accumulator column"
                "load":
                  "tmem_chunk":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Read 32 accumulator columns for this warp's 32 rows\
                      \ into registers"
                "store":
                  "rout_bulk":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "quadrant_full means this warp's 32 rows are all valid;\
                      \ stage the chunk in the sink slot, publish it, then lane 0\
                      \ issues one bulk store into rout"
                  "rout_masked":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Write the chunk straight to rout from the lanes whose\
                      \ route is valid, used when the quadrant is not full"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait every warp of the CTA runs before\
                      \ the roles diverge; done covers this role reaching it"
                  "setup":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Take part in the CTA rendezvous that follows barrier\
                      \ initialization and TMEM allocation"
                  "accumulator_full":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the products of item t have retired and\
                      \ the accumulator is readable by all four warps"
                  "tmem_drain":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait for the two 32-column reads of this pair, issued\
                      \ back to back so one latency covers both chunks"
                  "sink_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Wait until the previous bulk store of this warp's\
                      \ sink slot has consumed it; the global write may still be in\
                      \ flight"
                  "stores_drained":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Once per warp at grid exit, wait until every bulk\
                      \ store has completed globally, which is what the successor\
                      \ submission observes"
                  "retire":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "CTA-wide rendezvous after the last item; done covers\
                      \ every role having reached it"
                "signal":
                  "accumulator_free":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Each of the four warps arrives once its last pair's\
                      \ accumulator reads have retired; the stores may still be in\
                      \ flight"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "if(worktile_count > 0)":
              - "await:setup"
              - "for(t)":
                - "await:accumulator_full(t)"
                - "for(cp=0:2)":
                  - "load:tmem_chunk(t,2*cp)"
                  - "load:tmem_chunk(t,2*cp+1)"
                  - "await:tmem_drain(t,cp)"
                  - "if(cp == 1)":
                    - "signal:accumulator_free(t)"
                  - "for(c=2*cp:2*cp+2)":
                    - "compute:rout_bf16(t,c)"
                    - "if(quadrant_full)":
                      - "await:sink_free(t,c)"
                      - "store:rout_bulk(t,c)"
                    - "if(not quadrant_full)":
                      - "store:rout_masked(t,c)"
              - "await:stores_drained"
              - "await:retire"
            "Waiting":
              "Prepared":
              - "{done await:setup} ← [{done PRODA::compute:setup}]"
              - "{done await:accumulator_full(t)} ← [{done MMA::signal:accumulator_full(t)}]"
              - "{done await:tmem_drain(t,cp)} ← [{done load:tmem_chunk(t,2*cp)},\
                \ {done load:tmem_chunk(t,2*cp+1)}]"
              - "{done await:stores_drained} ← [{done store:rout_bulk(t,c)}]"
      "FINALIZE":
        "Role":
          "MAIN":
            "Info":
              "Describe": "Reduce one block of a token's hidden channels over that\
                \ token's routes and write the output"
              "Member": "warp[0:4]"
              "Using_verb":
                "compute":
                  "weighted_sum":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Each thread reads its token's route_of and scores,\
                      \ then accumulates fp32 of its four rout values times the score\
                      \ in ascending slot order from zero"
                "store":
                  "output":
                    "execution_mode": "async_unordered"
                    "describe": "Round the four accumulators to BF16 nearest even\
                      \ and write the thread's 8-byte output chunk; every element\
                      \ is written"
                "await":
                  "predecessor":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "Grid-wide wait until every prior submission has completed\
                      \ and flushed its writes; done covers the whole CTA"
                "signal":
                  "launch_dependents":
                    "execution_mode": "serial"
                    "describe": "One warp per CTA permits the successor submission\
                      \ to launch; the grid signals once every CTA has run it"
            "Pipe":
            - "await:predecessor"
            - "signal:launch_dependents"
            - "compute:weighted_sum"
            - "store:output"
